items.description: Landlord must cause the casualty repair to occur after a Casualty Event damages the Building or Tenant Space, subject to the termination rights.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, subject to the terms of this Section 9.1.1, and Sections 9.1.1.1 and 9.1.1.2, below, cause the Casualty Repair to occur.
items.trigger: If, during the Term of this Lease, any portion of the Building or the Tenant Space shall be damaged or destroyed, in whole or in part, by a Casualty Event

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant the Casualty Repair Notice as soon as reasonably practicable after a Casualty Event.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide the Casualty Repair Notice to Tenant as soon as is reasonably practicable following the Casualty Event.

items.description: Landlord may terminate the Lease by written notice in the Casualty Repair Notice if the estimated repair period exceeds ninety days.
items.span_text: in the event that the Repair Period-Estimated exceeds ninety (90) days, Landlord shall have the right to terminate this Lease by, and effective upon, written notice to Tenant as part of the Casualty Repair Notice.
items.trigger: in the event that the Repair Period-Estimated exceeds ninety (90) days

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by written notice if casualty damage prevents access or materially impairs use and the estimated or actual repair period exceeds ninety days.
items.span_text: then Tenant shall have the right to terminate this Lease by, and effective upon, written notice to Landlord if (i) the Repair Period-Estimated exceeds ninety (90) days (in which case Tenant must provide written notice to Landlord of such
items.trigger: If (a) a Casualty Event causes damage to the Tenant Space, or (b) a Casualty Event causes damage to the Building, such that Tenant is prevented from accessing the Premises or Tenant’s use of the Premises/Pathways for the Permitted Use is materially impaired

items.anchor_event: Tenant’s receipt of the Casualty Repair Notice
items.description: Tenant must give termination notice within sixty days after receiving the Casualty Repair Notice (estimated period case), or before the 100th day of the actual repair period.
items.span_text: termination within sixty (60) days after Tenant’s receipt of the Casualty Repair Notice), or (ii) the Repair Period-Actual exceeds ninety (90) days (in which case Tenant must provide written notice to Landlord of such termination prior to the one hundredth (100th) day of the Repair Period-Actual).

items.description: The Lease terminates automatically on a Casualty-Complete.
items.span_text: in the event of a Casualty-Complete, this Lease shall automatically terminate as of the date of the Casualty-Complete.
items.trigger: in the event of a Casualty-Complete

items.description: Landlord must refund prepaid Base Rent, net of sums Tenant owes, if the Lease is terminated after a casualty.
items.span_text: Landlord shall refund to Tenant any prepaid Base Rent, less any sum then owing to Landlord by Tenant.
items.trigger: In the event that this Lease is terminated pursuant to Sections 9.1.1.1, 9.1.1.2 or 9.1.1.3, above

items.description: Base Rent is abated proportionately during the repair period where the space is unfit and unused, if the Lease is not terminated.
items.span_text: Base Rent shall be abated proportionately during the Repair Period-Actual to the extent that the Tenant Space (i) is unfit for use by Tenant in the ordinary conduct of Tenant’s business, and (ii) actually is not used by Tenant.
items.trigger: If, however, this Lease is not terminated pursuant to any of said Sections

items.anchor_event: Landlord received notice of such Taking
items.description: Landlord may terminate the Lease after a partial Taking of material space by notice within sixty days after learning of the Taking.
items.span_text: Landlord may terminate this Lease by notice to Tenant given within sixty (60) days following the date upon which Landlord received notice of such Taking.
items.trigger: If the part of the Building or the Property that is taken or condemned as part of the Taking contains a part of the Tenant Space, the Building or the Property that, in Landlord’s reasonable discretion, is material to the operation of the Tenant Space

items.anchor_event: Tenant received notice of such Taking
items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease after a partial Taking affecting the Premises or access/use by notice within sixty days after learning of the Taking.
items.span_text: Tenant may terminate this Lease by notice to Landlord given within sixty (60) days following the date upon which Tenant received notice of such Taking.
items.trigger: if, by reason of such Taking, Tenant no longer has reasonable means of access to the Tenant Space or Tenant’s Permitted Use of the Premises is materially impaired

items.description: Landlord must restore the remaining Tenant Space at its own expense as soon as reasonably practicable after a Taking if the Lease is not terminated.
items.span_text: Landlord, at Landlord’s expense, shall, as soon as is reasonably practicable, restore that part of the Tenant Space that was not taken or condemned as part of the Taking
items.trigger: If this Lease shall not have been terminated pursuant to Sections 9.1.2.3 or 9.1.2.4, above

items.description: Landlord must refund prepaid Base Rent, net of sums owed, if the Lease is terminated due to a Taking.
items.span_text: Landlord shall refund to Tenant any prepaid Base Rent, less any sum then owing to Landlord by Tenant.
items.trigger: In the event that this Lease is terminated pursuant to Sections 9.1.2.1, 9.1.2.3 or 9.1.2.4, above

items.description: The party first receiving an award that includes an amount for the other must promptly account for it to the other.
items.span_text: the party first receiving the same shall promptly make an accounting of same to the other.
items.trigger: If any such award that is made, or compensation that is paid, to either party specifically includes an award or amount for the other

items.description: Tenant must procure and maintain insurance throughout the Term per Exhibit B-1.
items.span_text: Tenant shall, at Tenant’s expense, procure and maintain throughout the Term of this Lease a policy or policies of insurance in accordance with the terms and requirements set forth in Exhibit “B-1” to this Lease.

items.description: Tenant's liability policies must name Landlord, its managing agent and designated Holders as additional insureds.
items.span_text: The commercial general liability policies procured by Tenant hereunder shall name Landlord and Landlord’s managing agent, and any Holders designated by Landlord as additional insureds.

items.description: Tenant must submit insurance certificates before occupying and before each policy expires.
items.span_text: Prior to occupying the Tenant Space, and prior to the expiration of each such policy, Tenant shall submit to Landlord certificates of insurance evidencing such policies (and the applicable renewals thereof) being in effect.

items.description: Landlord must procure and maintain insurance throughout the Term per Exhibit B-2.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, at Landlord’s expense, procure and maintain throughout the Term of this Lease a policy or policies of insurance in accordance with the terms and requirements set forth in Exhibit “B-2” to this Lease.

items.description: Tenant may not make a Transfer without Landlord's prior written consent, which cannot be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not effect a Transfer, without Landlord’s express prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.

items.anchor_event: proposed effective date of the Transfer
items.description: Tenant must submit a Transfer Notice to Landlord before the proposed effective date of a Transfer.
items.span_text: then at least ten (10) business days (but no more than one hundred eighty (180) days) prior to the proposed effective date of the Transfer, Tenant shall submit a Transfer Notice to Landlord.
items.trigger: If Tenant desires to make any Transfer (other than a Permitted Transfer, for which Tenant must merely notify Landlord prior to the occurrence of same)

items.description: Landlord may recapture by terminating the Lease via written notice within ten business days after receiving the Transfer information.
items.span_text: Landlord shall have the right (but not the obligation), exercisable by written notice to Tenant, to elect to cancel and terminate this Lease.
items.trigger: at any time within ten (10) business days after Landlord’s receipt of all (but not less than all) of the information and documents described in Section 10.2
